name: Hilde Vautmans - Après le § 2 - Am 23
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: 2a. Welcomes the significant contribution of China in recent decades to global poverty reduction, and calls for the EU and China to jointly launch an ‘EU-China Global Sustainable Development Initiative’ aimed at supporting low-income countries through infrastructure, renewable energy, health systems and education, urbanisation, sustainable agriculture, digital connectivity and climate-resilient infrastructure, with full respect for social and environmental standards and debt sustainability, thus combining EU regulatory strengths with China’s capacity for mobilising public investment;
